title: Hub does not check that a newly set room_metadata room_uri is the room's ID
description: Decision mimid-1wgh.64 item 2: the hub refuses any change of a non-empty room_uri but lets any participant set one where it is empty or room_metadata is absent (as jmap_projection's rename tests do, adding room_metadata to a room created without it). It does not check the value is the room's own ID, which JMAP Room/create checks at creation (room_create.rs) and which agents take as the room's identity from a Welcome. Fix: carry the room ID into policy::RoomState (room_state has only the Observer) and refuse any other value.
